q: How do I get a price?
a: Send your order through our order form or on WhatsApp: the stock you want, roughly how many and your town or district. We reply within one business day with a price and a delivery date.
It depends on the stock. Tell us roughly how many you need and we’ll tell you whether we can supply it.

q: Do you deliver, or can I collect?
a: We deliver across Zimbabwe and quote transport with your order. You can also collect from our farm in Masvingo; message us first so your stock is ready when you arrive.

q: How far ahead should I order?
a: At least three weeks before you want delivery. That gives us time to confirm availability and complete vaccinations. If you need stock sooner, ask us what is ready now.

q: Is my order booked as soon as I send it?
a: Not yet. We reply with a price and delivery date, and your order is booked once you’ve agreed them with us.

q: Can you supply feed and brooding equipment too?
a: Yes. We can supply feed, vaccines and brooding equipment with your stock. Tick the box on the order form and we’ll quote everything together.

q: What help do I get after delivery?
a: Our field officers and partner vets are on call for the whole cycle for health checks, mortality investigations, and growth and feed checks against target. Day-old chick orders also get a dedicated WhatsApp line for the first 14 days.
